result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but several rendering defects stand out: an image in the 'Popular right now' section is stuck in a loading state, text in the horizontal carousel is hard-clipped without an ellipsis, favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards, and one card thumbnail renders with a mismatched light background.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a spinner overlaid in the centre of an already-rendered image, suggesting a stuck/duplicated loading indicator or an image that never finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading spinner once the image resolves, and add a timeout/fallback placeholder so the loader cannot persist over loaded content.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title ('Trattoria Piccol…') and its delivery price are hard-cut by the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, making the card look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek offset for the carousel and apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a fixed card width so partially visible cards read as intentional.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favorite button background, size and icon colour across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while adjacent thumbnails in the same row are dark, creating an uneven visual rhythm and lower contrast for the white '15–25 min' badge.
issues.suggestion: Normalise image treatment (e.g. consistent dark gradient overlay) and ensure the time badge always has sufficient contrast against the image.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cropped abruptly by the bottom tab bar with no visible name or metadata, so it can look like a clipped/broken tile.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom scroll padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are never visually amputated at rest, and consider a subtle fade at the content edge.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text label, and the bell's red dot conveys state by colour alone.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels/alt text for icon buttons and pair the unread indicator with a count or text so state is not colour-only.
